evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/n/a as rs.interfaces.DevCommands.

Exact v308 exposes one static Client/String/String[] command dispatcher with a large literal switch over developer commands including checkscreen, repack, gfxdata, animdata, dumpclip, dumpcommands, region, mapfile, resetnpcdefs, dumpitems and resetgraphs.

The dispatcher performs developer/cache/definition diagnostics and mutations against Client and definition/cache subsystems rather than ordinary player command transport, matching the source-level DevCommands identity.

candidates.note: Source-proven developer command dispatcher; this is distinct from R172 ClientCommandProcessor.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/n/c as rs.interfaces.widgets.Widget.

Exact v308 rs/n/c is abstract, extends R56 RSInterface, owns the shared font/resource array plus a build-state flag, and defines the abstract no-arg build operation inherited by the custom interface widget-builder family.

Dozens of exact-v308 rs/n/c/* interface classes extend this base, including already-reviewed concrete interfaces such as EquipmentInterface, ConstructionRoomSelectionInterface and many custom SpawnPK panels.
Client directly references the rs/n/c base in addition to the large concrete subclass family, proving it is live widget/interface infrastructure rather than an isolated source-map artifact.

candidates.note: Source-proven custom Widget base layered over the legacy R56 RSInterface definition object.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/n/d as rs.interfaces.WidgetManager.

Exact v308 owns the static List<rs.n.c> custom-widget registry and shared font/resource array; initialization clears the list, resets related dropdown/task state and constructs/registers the concrete rs/n/c widget family.

The manager's initialization method instantiates a long sequence of concrete Widget subclasses and routes each through one shared registration method, fixing it as the central custom widget/interface manager.
Client plus gameframe/interface code reference this manager directly, and concrete widget classes call back into it for shared registration/state.

candidates.note: Source-proven manager for the custom rs/n/c Widget family; distinct from R284 InterfaceLayoutManager.
